summary: The customer, Daniel Okafor, called because a refund had not reached his account. He said he had cancelled his Northwind Telecom contract in August and was promised a refund of $312.40. Daniel read out his bank account GB82 WEST 1234 5698 7654 32 and asked us to confirm it was the one on file. He also gave a new mobile number, +44 7700 900123, and asked that we stop using his old email daniel.o@example.test. During the call Mr. Okafor mentioned he had moved to 7 Ferry Road, Leith, Edinburgh EH6 4AE. His partner, Grace Bello, is authorised to speak on the account. Daniel was polite but frustrated, and asked for a supervisor callback within two working days.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks for calling, how can I help today?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, this is Daniel. I am still waiting for my refund from August.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I am sorry about that. Let me check the account.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Grace already called last week and was told it was processed.
